name: affine-connector
description: Single AFFiNE connector for ChatGPT using the authenticated native workspace MCP for read, write and document lifecycle operations.

interface.shortDescription: Use AFFiNE document read, write, trash, restore and delete through one connector.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT connects only to the Bratonien AFFiNE connector. The connector dynamically forwards the authenticated native AFFiNE workspace MCP, including read, search, create, update, metadata, trash, restore and permanent deletion. No secondary AFFiNE login or session channel is used.
defaultPrompt: Update or delete this AFFiNE document for me.
